description: We are Palafito Labs (Chiloé). We have built a mission simulator for young astronauts: a crew travels to the Space Station and tends to a crop of *Fragaria chiloensis*—Chile’s native strawberry—with support from mission control and a satellite, through games played on mobile devices, PCs, and in virtual reality. We use real NASA data and clearly label what is simulated. We are looking for expertise in graphic design, animation, video production, education, and science
